    A09-01 (traceback leak in mcp_safe_execute):
      Verification: mcp_errors.py lines 79-82:
        import os
        details = None
        if os.environ.get("ENABLE_DEBUG_TRACEBACKS", "").lower() in ("1", "true"):
            details = {"traceback": traceback.format_exc()[-500:]}
      Traceback is only populated when ENABLE_DEBUG_TRACEBACKS is explicitly set to
      "1" or "true". Default runtime (env var absent or any other value) yields
      details=None; no traceback fragment appears in the mcp_safe_execute error payload.
      Status: VERIFIED FIXED
